name: Follow the line
title: How does your morning feel?
note: Follow the line carousel posted; system Pillow was broken so it was reinstalled with --ignore-installed
caption:
Which line did you follow? Tell us the number.

However your morning feels, worried, tired, alone or thankful, God meets you right where you are. He cares for you, gives rest to the weary, stays close in the dark valleys, and is worth thanking in every season.

Matthew 11:28, 1 Peter 5:7, Psalm 23:4, 1 Thessalonians 5:18 (BSB)
